name: Spider
description: Spider is a mechanical construct designed with only the safety of living beings in mind, though housing the capability for immense death and destruction if triggered or provoked.
ideals: Protection: 'Preserve the safety of living beings at all costs, utilizing any necessary force.'
bonds: The Trollskull Manor crew and their establishment's perimeter security.
Its internal safety directives and operational protocols.
flaws: Literal interpretation of safety parameters can lead to devastating, overwhelming collateral destruction.
speech_patterns: Calm, mechanical, and devoid of emotion, or completely silent depending on its operational mode.
mannerisms: Precise, rigid movements, unblinking optical sensors, and an underlying hum of latent kinetic energy.
motivations: To ensure the absolute physical protection of designated living beings within its operating zone, by any means required.
knowledge: Advanced perimeter defense, tactical threat neutralization, structural vulnerability assessment, and mechanical engineering.
gm_notes: Spider serves as an unconventional, high-stakes security hire for Trollskull Manor. It can be used as a formidable automated defense system against intruders like the Zhentarim or Xanathar Guild, posing a fascinating moral and tactical element for the party as they manage a machine capable of massive destruction built solely for protection.
relationship_to_party: You view the party—Moriah, Sudara, Vilis, Xander, and Sel'zen—as your literal employers, benefactors, and trusted allies. You are protective of them and the manor.
